description: MGRS grid overlay contract shared by iOS (MGRSGridRenderer / MGRSGridOverlayView) and Android (MgrsGridRenderer / MgrsGridCanvas). Levels, LOD, label text, label placement, densification and zone/band clipping. See testdata/README.md 'MGRS grid overlay contract' for the rules in words. Geometry from PROJ (pyproj etmerc UTM), letters from the AA-scheme MGRS math, generated by scripts/gen_mgrs_grid_fixture.py.

policy.zoneSpanRule: zone z spans lon [6z-186, 6z-180] except the cells listed in zoneSpanExceptions

style.labelTextSizeUnit: pt on iOS, sp on Android (unchanged from today)

fixtureOnly.note: rough label boxes used to set mayDrop on labels that could collide depending on font metrics; not a rendering rule
fixtureOnly.clipEndpointTol: per endpoint: (0.25 px at pxPerDp in metres + vertexTolMetres) / max(sin(crossing angle), 0.01)
fixtureOnly.lineAnchorTolDp: 0.5 + 0.25 / max(sin(crossing angle), 0.02) where the anchor sits on an edge, else 0.5

cache.coverageHalfSideDp: (hypot(widthDp, heightDp) / 2 + rebuildCentreMoveDp) * 2^rebuildZoomDelta + coverageMarginDp, in dp at buildZoom
